body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Creative unveiled its in-ear earphone 'Aurvana In-Ear 2' during Showstoppers at CES 2010.

The precise Balanced Armature driver is mated with an acoustic grille design for detailed and smooth audio response complemented by punchy lows. This delivers an overall warmer and fuller presentation suitable for a wide genre of music, vocals or soundtracks.
